examples.name: start
examples.requirements: Run each marked stage in a separate resident workbench cell, in order. The Project.BackgroundCommandExample source must be on the selected source path. Query evidence after completion, then finish the watcher.

examples.name: readSnapshot
examples.requirements: Requires FsRead, FsWrite and Console. Uses and replaces the named scratch note. Read contents and version together, commit to that captured destination, and observe stale-write refusal. Only filesystem-effect writers participate in the shared advisory lock; external writers are outside the guarantee.

examples.name: lookupIndex
examples.requirements: Import Project.RetainedLookupExample and call capture with Lookup available. Display lookupIndex of the returned batch, then sections or firstSignatureLine. Navigation is pure over that exact batch; missing examples/source are explicit, and no discovered runtime authority or upstream completeness is implied.

examples.name: requestWithReplyTool
examples.requirements: Run in a resident workbench with AgentLaunch, Replies, Watches and Console available and a configured Luna model. Project.Researcher must be on the selected source path. The child requires Web support and network access for search and open; the caller does not need Web. SameDir shares the writable selected workspace. Validates the child spec, awaits a sourced Report, then awaits a distinct FollowUp using the active reply tool for each request.

examples.name: runQuery
examples.requirements: Run the cells in order with Jev and Console. Requires the workspace pinned Jev.Core source root and matched Tidepool runtime; native JSON intrinsics are not ordinary GHC execution. Only the explicit runSelection stage executes a continuation. Real observations require a configured Jev provider; policy comparison does not. See checks/jev-composition.md.

examples.name: captureThenAssess
examples.requirements: Requires Lookup, Reflect, Jev and Console, the workspace pinned Jev.Core source root, matched Tidepool runtime, and configured Jev provider. Capture retains original candidates, ranking Evaluation and bounded exact view-fenced expansion; dependent reassessment includes bounded content/status with truncation flags. See checks/jev-composition.md.

examples.name: recordings
examples.requirements: Run save before replay. Requires Jev, FsWrite, Console and a configured Jev provider. Writes .exomonad/state/jev-example.json using ordinary filesystem effects; direct write success does not promise durability. Requires pinned Jev.Core sources and matched native JSON runtime. See checks/jev-composition.md.

examples.name: replayProgram
examples.requirements: First run checks/jev-recording-save-example.hs. Edit a continuation payload in Examples/JevComposedWorkflow.hs and publish changed source through ordinary source reload before reconstructing this program. Requires FsRead and Console, pinned Jev.Core source root and matched Tidepool native JSON runtime. Replay makes zero provider calls; no Jev credential is needed. Payload-only changes are accepted; changed question/evidence/model is refused. See checks/jev-composition.md.
